newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude gains ground in late US paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude gains ground in late US paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil gained ground in another subdued day of U.S. paper trading on Thursday, traders said.
"It was a quiet day in the neighborhood," a New York dealer said.
Three partial August cargoes changed hands, twice at $17.98 and once at $18.00 a barrel.
The August contract on London's IPE settled at $17.96 a barrel.
Intermonth talk was muted. August/September was pegged at minus nine to minus eight cents, while September/October was assessed at minus 16/14 cents.
